_comment: conversation_history request contract shared by the Go store (history.go parseHistoryArgs) and the Core FakeState double. Every case must be accepted or rejected with the same message by both. 'observed' cases are the exact requests gpt-5.6-luna sent on the hosted L1 acceptance (2026-09-28) when Responses had normalized the tool into strict mode.

openai_responses_strict_normalization._comment: The conversation_history tool as the OpenAI Responses API echoed it in response.created (real gpt-5.6-luna call, 2026-09-28, tool definition identical to 289760b5 and b40fa578) when the request omitted `strict`: strict:true, and every property of the input object added to required.

query.description: Required only for search; literal substring of stored text or serialized record.

seq.description: Read one exact stored record; cannot combine with after_seq.

chunk_seq.description: Read the original records of one memory chunk's range; continue within that range by adding after_seq.

from_seq.description: Read records starting at this inclusive sequence.

after_seq.description: Continue after the last sequence returned on the preceding page.

content_offset.description: Only with read + seq. Unicode character offset into the journal_event_v1 JSON, as returned by next_read.
